map.输入导通时间 ton 与周期 T，按 D = ton / T × 100% 计算: Enter on-time ton and period T, and compute duty cycle by D = ton / T * 100%, used for PWM dimming, motor-speed control and duty-cycle parameter design of switching-power-supply waveforms.
map.输入导通时间 ton 与周期 T，求占空比。: Enter on-time ton and period T to compute duty cycle.
map.脉冲导通时间 ton 与周期 T 之比得占空比。: Pulse on-time ton divided by period T gives the duty cycle.
map.PWM 调光、电机调速的占空比设置。: PWM dimming and motor-speed control duty-cycle setting.
map.对比不同导通宽度下的平均效果。: Compare average effects under different on-time widths.
map.：占空比 D = 2/10 × 100% = 20%；若 ton 增到 5 则: : duty cycle D = 2/10 * 100% = 20%; if ton rises to 5 then D = 50% (half-period conducting).
map.：若 ton=T，则 D=100%，等于常通直流。: : if ton = T, then D = 100%, equal to always-on DC.
